hebrewText: לִ/בְנֵי קֶ֨דֶם֙ עַל בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וּ/נְתַתִּ֖י/הָ לְ/מֽוֹרָשָׁ֑ה לְמַ֛עַן לֹֽא תִזָּכֵ֥ר בְּנֵֽי עַמּ֖וֹן בַּ/גּוֹיִֽם

tokens.bdb: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)

tokens.kjv: aforetime, ancient (time), before, east (end, part, side, -ward), eternal, [idiom] ever(-lasting), forward, old, past. Compare H6926 (קִדְמָה).
